label: end of long sequence (input k or <DEL>, t>=7) when first token is d/i
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.01% of steps). Fires only at the end of the original phase or on the <DEL> step of long sequences (L=8-9, t=7-9; never in the copy phase, never before t=6). Within that window it fires almost only when the input is k (40% of mass) or <DEL> (49%). The first original token is strongly enriched for d (18x lift, 65% of mass) or i (7x). Activations are larger when tokens 1-2 are x/i/d and w came earlier (top example: d x i e r s w k). The predicate captures ~73% of activation mass but has very low precision (~4%): most long sequences that start with d/i and end in k/<DEL> do not activate it, so the feature seems to need a narrower conjunction of prefix contents that I could not isolate. Tighter conjunctions (orig(1) in x/i, w seen) raise precision to ~30% but recall drops below 20%.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=d (+5.36), orig0=i (+4.11), orig1=i (+3.80), prev_tok=w (+3.61), orig1=x (+3.27), phase=0 & in_tok=k (+3.10). Lower it: next_out=- (-4.31), correct=1 (-3.89), phase=2 (-3.74), orig6=- (-2.65).
